items.difficulty_reason: The author computes the kernel in a blow-up chart by induction and divisibility, then dehomogenizes a lifted relation and forces its coefficients into the ideal.
source_caveats: Positive degrees are selected. The printed Sym_A superscript is kept as it appears; the author’s construction explicitly starts the graded ring at A/I. Exercise 22.3.E asks for reading the positive homogeneous pieces of the displayed α.
